mapstr={
"################",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"##d###....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#..............#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#..............#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"#....#....#....#",
"################"}
FOV=0.66
PPU=64/FOV
SPD=0.075
TURN=0.032
MRAD=0.28
function reset()
 mp={}
 wl={}
 doorx=2
 doory=4
 for y=0,15 do
  local row=mapstr[y+1]
  for x=0,15 do
   local ch=sub(row,x+1,x+1)
   local t=0
   if ch=="#" then
    t=1
    add(wl,x)
    add(wl,y)
   elseif ch=="d" then
    t=2
   end
   mp[y*16+x+1]=t
  end
 end
 zb={}
 for i=1,64 do
  zb[i]=99
 end
 px=2.5
 py=13.5
 ang=0.75
 dirx=cos(ang)
 diry=sin(ang)
 planex=-diry*FOV
 planey=dirx*FOV
 key={x=12.5,y=2.5,size=0.55,yc=-0.2,spr=32,taken=false}
 gate={x=2.5,y=2.5,size=1,yc=0,spr=34}
 mon={x=7.5,y=9.5,tx=7,ty=9,pdx=0,pdy=-1,chase=false}
 olist={key,gate,mon}
 oidx={1,2,3}
 odep={-1,-1,-1}
 unlocked=false
 ticks=0
 msg="find the key"
 msgt=100
 stepcd=0
 warnt=0
 warncd=0
 near_key=false
 near_door=false
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(0,200,3)
end
function solid(tx,ty)
 if tx<0 or ty<0 or tx>15 or ty>15 then
  return true
 end
 return mp[ty*16+tx+1]!=0
end
function canmove(nx,ny)
 return not (solid(flr(nx-MRAD),flr(ny-MRAD)) or solid(flr(nx+MRAD),flr(ny-MRAD)) or solid(flr(nx-MRAD),flr(ny+MRAD)) or solid(flr(nx+MRAD),flr(ny+MRAD)))
end
function los(x0,y0,x1,y1)
 local dx=x1-x0
 local dy=y1-y0
 local d=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
 if d>7 then
  return false
 end
 local n=flr(d*3)+1
 local sx=dx/n
 local sy=dy/n
 local x=x0
 local y=y0
 for i=1,n do
  x+=sx
  y+=sy
  if solid(flr(x),flr(y)) then
   return false
  end
 end
 return true
end
function move_mon()
 local mspd=0.055
 if mon.chase then
  mspd=0.07
 end
 local tx=mon.tx+0.5
 local ty=mon.ty+0.5
 local mx=tx-mon.x
 local my=ty-mon.y
 local d=sqrt(mx*mx+my*my)
 if d>mspd then
  mon.x+=mx/d*mspd
  mon.y+=my/d*mspd
  return
 end
 mon.x=tx
 mon.y=ty
 local ntx=mon.tx
 local nty=mon.ty
 if mon.chase then
  local sx=(px>mon.x) and 1 or -1
  local sy=(py>mon.y) and 1 or -1
  local dx2=0
  local dy2=0
  if abs(px-mon.x)>=abs(py-mon.y) then
   if not solid(mon.tx+sx,mon.ty) then
    dx2=sx
   end
  else
   if not solid(mon.tx,mon.ty+sy) then
    dy2=sy
   end
  end
  if dx2==0 and dy2==0 then
   if not solid(mon.tx+sx,mon.ty) then
    dx2=sx
   elseif not solid(mon.tx,mon.ty+sy) then
    dy2=sy
   end
  end
  if dx2!=0 or dy2!=0 then
   ntx=mon.tx+dx2
   nty=mon.ty+dy2
   mon.pdx=dx2
   mon.pdy=dy2
  end
 end
 if ntx==mon.tx and nty==mon.ty then
  if solid(mon.tx+mon.pdx,mon.ty+mon.pdy) then
   mon.pdx=-mon.pdx
   mon.pdy=-mon.pdy
  end
  ntx=mon.tx+mon.pdx
  nty=mon.ty+mon.pdy
 end
 mon.tx=ntx
 mon.ty=nty
end
function updateplay()
 ticks+=1
 if msgt>0 then
  msgt-=1
  if msgt<=0 then
   msg=""
  end
 end
 if warnt>0 then
  warnt-=1
 end
 if stepcd>0 then
  stepcd-=1
 end
 if btn(0) then
  ang-=TURN
 end
 if btn(1) then
  ang+=TURN
 end
 ang=ang%1
 dirx=cos(ang)
 diry=sin(ang)
 planex=-diry*FOV
 planey=dirx*FOV
 local mv=(btn(2) and 1 or 0)-(btn(3) and 1 or 0)
 if mv!=0 then
  local nx=px+dirx*SPD*mv
  local ny=py+diry*SPD*mv
  local moved=false
  if canmove(nx,py) then
   px=nx
   moved=true
  end
  if canmove(px,ny) then
   py=ny
   moved=true
  end
  if moved and stepcd<=0 then
   sfx(5,3)
   stepcd=9
  end
 end
 local mdx=px-mon.x
 local mdy=py-mon.y
 local md=sqrt(mdx*mdx+mdy*mdy)
 mon.chase=false
 if ticks>60 and md<6 and los(mon.x,mon.y,px,py) then
  mon.chase=true
 end
 if mon.chase and md<4.5 then
  warnt=16
  if ticks-warncd>45 then
   sfx(16,3)
   warncd=ticks
  end
 end
 move_mon()
 mdx=px-mon.x
 mdy=py-mon.y
 if mdx*mdx+mdy*mdy<0.36 then
  state="dead"
  music(-1,200)
  sfx(4,3)
  return
 end
 near_key=false
 near_door=false
 if not key.taken then
  local kx=key.x-px
  local ky=key.y-py
  near_key=(kx*kx+ky*ky<0.81)
 end
 if not unlocked then
  local dxo=doorx+0.5-px
  local dyo=doory+0.5-py
  local dd=sqrt(dxo*dxo+dyo*dyo)
  if dd>0 and dd<1.5 and (dxo*dirx+dyo*diry)/dd>0.45 then
   near_door=true
  end
 end
 if btnp(4) then
  if near_key then
   key.taken=true
   sfx(0,3)
   msg="got the key!"
   msgt=80
  elseif near_door then
   if key.taken then
    unlocked=true
    mp[doory*16+doorx+1]=0
    sfx(17,3)
    msg="the gate is open!"
    msgt=90
   else
    sfx(18,3)
    msg="locked - need the key"
    msgt=80
   end
  end
 end
 if unlocked then
  local gx=gate.x-px
  local gy=gate.y-py
  if gx*gx+gy*gy<0.36 then
   state="win"
   music(-1,200)
   sfx(3,3)
  end
 end
end
function _init()
 reset()
 state="title"
end
function _update()
 if state=="title" then
  if btnp(4) then
   reset()
   state="play"
  end
  return
 end
 if state=="play" then
  updateplay()
  return
 end
 if btnp(4) then
  reset()
  state="play"
 end
 if btnp(5) then
  state="title"
  sfx(-1,3)
  music(0,200,3)
 end
end
function drawobj(o,d,ismon)
 local dx=o.x-px
 local dy=o.y-py
 local lat=dx*(-diry)+dy*dirx
 local sxc=64+64*(lat/(FOV*d))
 local s=o.size
 if ismon and mon.chase then
  s=s*1.2
 end
 local sz=flr(s*PPU/d)
 if sz<1 then
  sz=1
 end
 local top=flr(64-o.yc*PPU/d-sz*0.5)
 local left=sxc-sz*0.5
 local c0=flr(left+0.5)
 local c1=c0+sz-1
 local st=2
 if sz>32 then
  st=4
 end
 if sz>64 then
  st=8
 end
 local c=c0
 while c<=c1 do
  local cc=c
  if cc<0 then
   cc=0
  end
  if cc<128 then
   local ci=flr((cc+st*0.5)/2)
   if ci<0 then
    ci=0
   end
   if ci>63 then
    ci=63
   end
   if d<zb[ci+1] then
    local su=flr(((c+st*0.5)-left)/sz*8)
    if su<0 then
     su=0
    end
    if su>7 then
     su=7
    end
    local w=st
    if c1-c+1<st then
     w=c1-c+1
    end
    sspr(su,0,1,8,cc,top,w,sz)
   end
  end
  c+=st
 end
end
function drawobjects()
 odep[1]=(key.x-px)*dirx+(key.y-py)*diry
 odep[2]=(gate.x-px)*dirx+(gate.y-py)*diry
 odep[3]=(mon.x-px)*dirx+(mon.y-py)*diry
 oidx[1]=1
 oidx[2]=2
 oidx[3]=3
 for i=1,2 do
  for j=i+1,3 do
   if odep[oidx[j]]>odep[oidx[i]] then
    local tmp=oidx[i]
    oidx[i]=oidx[j]
    oidx[j]=tmp
   end
  end
 end
 for i=1,3 do
  local id=oidx[i]
  local d=odep[id]
  if d>0.25 then
   local skip=(id==1 and key.taken) or (id==2 and not unlocked)
   if not skip then
    drawobj(olist[id],d,id==3)
   end
  end
 end
end
function scene()
 rectfill(0,0,127,63,0)
 rectfill(0,64,127,127,2)
 rectfill(0,63,127,63,1)
 for c=0,63 do
  local camx=(c+0.5)/32-1
  local rx=dirx+planex*camx
  local ry=diry+planey*camx
  local mx=flr(px)
  local my=flr(py)
  local ddx=9999
  local ddy=9999
  if abs(rx)>0.005 then
   ddx=abs(1/rx)
  end
  if abs(ry)>0.005 then
   ddy=abs(1/ry)
  end
  local stx=0
  local sty=0
  local sdx=0
  local sdy=0
  if rx>0 then
   stx=1
   sdx=(mx+1-px)*ddx
  else
   stx=-1
   sdx=(px-mx)*ddx
  end
  if ry>0 then
   sty=1
   sdy=(my+1-py)*ddy
  else
   sty=-1
   sdy=(py-my)*ddy
  end
  local side=0
  local t=1
  local perp=0
  for i=1,40 do
   if sdx<sdy then
    sdx+=ddx
    mx+=stx
    side=0
    perp=sdx-ddx
   else
    sdy+=ddy
    my+=sty
    side=1
    perp=sdy-ddy
   end
   if mx<0 or my<0 or mx>15 or my>15 then
    t=1
    break
   end
   t=mp[my*16+mx+1]
   if t!=0 then
    break
   end
  end
  if perp<0.06 then
   perp=0.06
  end
  zb[c+1]=perp
  local lh=PPU/perp
  local y0=64-lh*0.5
  local y1=64+lh*0.5
  local col
  if t==2 then
   col=perp<4 and 9 or 4
  elseif perp<3 then
   col=side==0 and 6 or 5
  elseif perp<6 then
   col=side==0 and 5 or 13
  else
   col=side==0 and 13 or 1
  end
  rectfill(c*2,flr(y0),c*2+1,flr(y1),col)
 end
 drawobjects()
end
function ctr(t,y,col)
 print(t,(128-#t*4)/2,y,col)
end
function hud()
 rectfill(0,0,127,9,0)
 spr(32,2,1)
 print("key "..(key.taken and "1/1" or "0/1"),12,2,key.taken and 11 or 6)
 print(unlocked and "gate open" or "gate locked",78,2,unlocked and 11 or 4)
 rectfill(103,11,120,28,0)
 local i=1
 while i<=#wl do
  pset(104+wl[i],12+wl[i+1],5)
  i+=2
 end
 if not key.taken then
  pset(104+flr(key.x),12+flr(key.y),10)
 end
 if unlocked then
  pset(104+flr(gate.x),12+flr(gate.y),11)
 else
  pset(104+doorx,12+doory,9)
 end
 pset(104+flr(px),12+flr(py),7)
 pset(104+flr(px+dirx*1.6),12+flr(py+diry*1.6),6)
 rectfill(0,109,127,118,0)
 if msgt>0 then
  ctr(msg,111,10)
 else
  local p
  if near_key then
   p="o: take the key"
  elseif near_door then
   if key.taken then
    p="o: unlock the gate"
   else
    p="o: locked - need the key"
   end
  elseif unlocked then
   p="walk into the green gate"
  else
   p="find the key, open the gate"
  end
  ctr(p,111,7)
 end
 if warnt>0 then
  rectfill(16,95,111,105,0)
  ctr("! the eye sees you !",98,8)
  if flr(ticks)%8<4 then
   rect(0,0,127,127,8)
  end
 end
end
function titlescreen()
 cls(0)
 rectfill(0,0,127,127,1)
 rectfill(6,6,121,121,0)
 spr(32,22,20,2,2)
 spr(33,86,20,2,2)
 ctr("dungeon key",48,7)
 ctr("left/right: turn",62,6)
 ctr("up/down: walk",70,6)
 ctr("o: take key / open gate",78,6)
 ctr("take the key, open the gate,",92,10)
 ctr("escape - the eye is death",100,10)
 ctr("press o to start",112,7)
end
function _draw()
 if state=="title" then
  titlescreen()
  return
 end
 scene()
 if state=="play" then
  hud()
 elseif state=="dead" then
  rectfill(0,44,127,86,0)
  ctr("the eye caught you",50,8)
  ctr("press o to try again",62,7)
  ctr("x: title",74,6)
 elseif state=="win" then
  rectfill(0,44,127,86,0)
  ctr("you escaped!",50,11)
  ctr("time "..flr(ticks/30).."s",62,7)
  ctr("o: again  x: title",74,6)
 end
end
title: 地牢之钥 3D

design.core_action: 第一人称格子里用左右方向键转身、上下方向键前进后退，在 2.5D 射线地牢中走到钥匙旁按 O 拾取，再走到橙色门前按 O 开锁，最后走进门内绿门。
design.goal: 拿到钥匙（HUD key 0/1 变绿）→ 用 O 打开橙色门（gate locked 变 gate open）→ 走进绿色传送门 → win 画面显示逃脱用时。
design.risk: 走廊里巡逻的注视之眼：玩家进入其视线 6 格内会追击，贴近 4.5 格时屏幕红闪并发出警报声，被贴身 0.6 格即失败（dead 画面）。怪物速度低于玩家，可绕柱摆脱。
design.controls: 左/右=转身，上=前进，下=后退，O=互动（拿钥匙/开门）与开始、重开，X=回到标题。失败或胜利后 O 重新开始。
design.scenes: title 标题与操作说明 → play 3D 地牢（16x16 三竖厅两条横向走廊，外墙闭合）→ dead 被抓 / win 逃脱，均可 O 重开、X 回标题。
design.audiovisual: Kajam 迷宫曲 pattern0（music(0,200,3)，声道3留给音效）；脚步 sfx5 有冷却，拿钥匙 sfx0，开锁自定义 sfx17，缺钥匙拒绝自定义 sfx18，危险警报自定义 sfx16，胜利 sfx3，失败 sfx4 并先停 BGM。3D 画面：64 条 2 像素射线墙柱、按深度分色的墙面与橙色door、右下角小地图、顶部 HUD、底部提示条。
preserve: 第一人称射线 3D 渲染，不降为俯视
closed outer wall map and 2px column raycaster
钥匙在开门前可达（已用地图连通性检查）
billboard 逐列与 z-buffer 比较，物品不显示在墙后
O 键重新开始失败局
unresolved: 尚未试玩：注视之眼的追击压迫感与普通移动手感（转向 0.032 圈/帧、速度 0.075 格/帧）需要实机确认
门内小厅若被怪物跟进会成为死路，是否可接受需试玩判断
